video.title: Memphis City Council: May 12, 2026
video.description:
All official, complete recordings of Council meetings remain publicly available through the City's Granicus system, which is the permanent and authoritative source for all Council video archives.

https://www.memphistn.gov/watch-city-council-meetings/
